comment: Manual skip/override set for perl 5.22, built from the 2026-08-22 downstream re-evaluation (cleared-list run, classified per CLAUDE.md skip_codegen policy). Only entries that still fail after apidoc data 1.3-1.10 and the codegen fixes are registered.

patches.name: Perl_atof
patches.source_loc: perl-5.20/5.22 perl.h (#define Perl_atof(s) Perl_my_atof(s) under USE_PERL_ATOF)
patches.reason: The macro lacks aTHX_: Perl_my_atof takes (pTHX_ const char *s) on threaded builds, so the expansion is a 1-arg call to a 2-arg function (E0061). Latent in C because core code calls my_atof (embed.h adds aTHX_). Fixed upstream in 5.36. Same entry as in v5.32/v5.34.patches.json.

patches.name: S_perl_hash_djb2
patches.reason: Internal hash-function inline (hv_func.h) removed/reworked in modern perl. The old implementations use loop macros that reassign their induction variable (E0384 MURMUR_DOBYTES), u8/u32 mixed arithmetic (E0277) and assignment-position casts (E0067) that the codegen does not support. S_-prefixed internal implementation, not public API. Verified still failing in the 2026-08-22 re-evaluation.

patches.name: sv_collxfrm
patches.reason: Upstream sv.h bug on this version: `#define sv_collxfrm(sv, nxp) sv_cmp_flags(sv, nxp, SV_GMAGIC)` calls sv_cmp_flags instead of sv_collxfrm_flags, passing STRLEN* where SV* is expected (E0308). Latent in C because core code never calls the short name. Same entry as v5.26; fixed upstream by 5.34.

patches.name: GvALIASED_SV_on
patches.reason: gv.h declares gp_flags as a 1-bit bitfield (PERL_BITFIELD32 gp_flags:1), so bindgen exposes it only via accessor methods and the generated `(*GvGP(gv)).gp_flags() |= / &= GPf_ALIASED_SV` has a method call on the left-hand side (E0067 invalid left-hand side of assignment). Bitfield write support (set_gp_flags) would be a new codegen feature (Signature Approval). 5.24+ does not generate these macros, so the shape is 5.22-only. No downstream user. Verified failing in the 2026-08-29 collection.

patches.reason: gv.h declares gp_flags as a 1-bit bitfield (PERL_BITFIELD32 gp_flags:1), so bindgen exposes it only via accessor methods and the generated `(*GvGP(gv)).gp_flags() |= / &= GPf_ALIASED_SV` has a method call on the left-hand side (E0067 invalid left-hand side of assignment). patches.name: S__is_utf8_char_slow
patches.reason: The inline body declares `STRLEN actual_len;` uninitialized and passes &actual_len as an out-param to Perl_utf8n_to_uvchr, so the generated `let mut actual_len: STRLEN;` + `&raw mut actual_len` is rejected by rustc (E0381 used binding isn't initialized). Out-param zero-initialization would be a future codegen fix. Generated only on the non-threaded build of this version (threaded legs do not generate it). Verified failing in the 2026-08-29 collection.

patches.reason: RCPV_* does not exist before perl 5.38 (cop.h RCPV refactor), so the common return_type_override has no target here and only emits a MISS warning (dict lookup fails; issue #17). Cancel the common patch on this version.
